# Records, Tuples, Bitfields & Enums

Edva provides **records** for product types (structs, tuples, SIMD vectors, packed headers, and bitfields) and **enums** for nominal tagged unions with $\ge 2$ named variants.

## Product types: records, tuples, `#packed`, and bitfields

### Record declaration forms

| Form | Syntax | Layout & Semantics | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Named record** | `#type Point (x: Int, y: Int = 0)` | C-ABI aligned struct; fields may declare default values (`= expr`) | `E2015`: missing comma on same line |
| **Multiline record** | `#type User`<br>`   id: Int`<br>`   name: String` | Indented or parenthesized multiline fields; newline separates aligned entries | — |
| **Positional tuple** | `#type Pair (Int, String)`<br>`p = (10, "ok")` | Accessed via `.0`, `.1`, ... | — |
| **Homogeneous / SIMD tuple** | `#type Vec4 (Float * 4)`<br>`v = 0.0 {4}` | Contiguous inline elements; supports `v(i)` indexing, `+`/`-`/`*`/`/` arithmetic, and `%` SIMD intrinsics | — |
| **Packed record** | `#type Hdr #packed (a: u8, b: u32)` | Alignment `1`, zero interior or tail padding | — |
| **Explicitly aligned record** | `#type Block #align 64 (data: u8 * 64)` | Power-of-two byte alignment `N`; `#size` tail-padded to multiple of `N` (combinable with `#packed`) | — |
| **Bitfield record** | `#type Tcp #packed u16 (syn: <>, ack: <>, win: 14)` | Packs 1-bit `<>` flags (`<->` default) and integer bit widths into `u8`, `u16`, `u32`, or `u64` | `E2055`: bit sum exceeds backing width |

### Record construction, access, and definite initialization

| Operation | Syntax | Semantics | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Positional construction** | `Point(10, 20)` / `(10, 20)` | Initializes fields in declaration order | `E3084`: field type/count mismatch |
| **Named construction** | `Point(y = 20, x = 10)` | Initializes by field name; omitted fields with defaults use their declared default value | — |
| **Zero/default value** | `Point.zero` | Initializes all fields to `0` / `<->` / `""` or their declared `= default` expression | — |
| **Forward declaration** | `p: Point` | Allocates uninitialized record storage; **every field must be written before being read** | `E3130`: reading uninitialized field |
| **Field read / write** | `p.x`, `p.0`, `p.x = 5` | Reads or mutates named, positional, or bitfield slot in place | — |
| **Field-accessor section** | `(.x)`, `(.0)`, `(.a.b)` | 1-argument projection function `r => r.x` | `E2064`: bare `(.)` |
| **Structural equality** | `p1 == p2`, `p1 != p2` | Compares all fields recursively | `E3084`: if record contains fn field |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

#type Point (x: Int = 0, y: Int = 0)
#type Flags #packed u8 (fin: <>, syn: <>, rest: 6)

p: Point
p.x = 10
p.y = 20

f' = Flags(fin = <->, syn = <+>, rest = 7)

io::out $ (p.x + p.y, f'.syn, f'.rest, #size Flags)
```

```{.dva expected-error="E3130"}
#type Point (x: Int, y: Int)
p: Point
p.x = 100
bad = p.y
```

## Sum types: nominal `Enum` (`< V1, V2(T) >`)

Enums model nominal tagged unions of two or more uppercase variants, represented at runtime as a 16-byte `{ i64 tag, ptr payload }` pair (`#size Enum == 16`). Because payloads are arena pointers, recursive enums (`#type Expr < Lit(Int), Add(Expr, Expr) >`) have fixed 16-byte size without explicit box types.

### Enum declaration and construction rules

| Rule / Operation | Syntax | Specification | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Declaration** | `#type Shape < Circle(Float), Rect(Float, Float), Dot >` | Requires $\ge 2$ unique uppercase variant labels separated by commas or aligned newlines | `E2070`: $< 2$ variants<br>`E2012`: lowercase label<br>`E2074`: duplicate label |
| **Unit variant construction** | `Shape(Dot)`, `Dot`, `Shape::Dot` | Bare `Dot` is bound in scope if unambiguous; use `Shape::Dot` when two enums share a label | `E3105`: ambiguous unqualified label<br>`E3098`: payload given to unit variant |
| **Payload construction** | `Shape(Circle, 5.0)`<br>`Shape(Rect, (3.0, 4.0))` | Type name called with variant label first, followed by payload argument(s) | `E3096`: unknown variant<br>`E3097`: missing payload<br>`E3099`: wrong payload type |
| **Structural equality** | `a == b`, `a != b` | Compares variant tags first, then payloads recursively (`<`, `>` ordering rejected) | `E3084` if fn payload<br>`E3127` on `<` / `>` |

### Enum pattern matching and reflection

| Pattern / Operation | Syntax | Semantics | Diagnostic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Unit / ignore-payload guard** | `[Dot]` / `[Dot, Circle]` | Matches tag(s); ignores any payload (`[Circle _]` is forbidden; write `[Circle]`) | `E2109`: redundant `_` in `[V _]` |
| **Payload binder guard** | `[Circle r]` | Matches `Circle` and binds payload to `r` (and implicit `_` in branch body) | — |
| **Deep nested pattern** | `[Add (Lit a, Neg (Lit b))]` | Recursively destructures nested enum and tuple/record payloads in a single guard | — |
| **Exhaustiveness** | All variants covered or trailing `|` | Required when choice result is used as a value | `E3102`: uncovered variants |
| **Compile-time count & label** | `?T`, `T.(i)` (with `#! T: Type`) | `?T` yields variant count; `T.(i)` yields `i`-th variant name (`String`) | `E3170`: non-constant `i` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

#type Expr < Lit(Int), Neg(Expr), Add(Expr, Expr) >

eval: Expr => Int
eval = e =>
   e
      [Lit n]              n
      [Neg (Lit n)]        0 - n
      [Neg x]              0 - eval(x)
      [Add (Lit 0, rhs)]   eval(rhs)
      [Add (lhs, rhs)]     eval(lhs) + eval(rhs)
      |                    0

e = Expr(Add, (Expr(Lit, 10), Expr(Neg, Expr(Lit, 3))))
io::out $ eval(e)   // 7
```
